SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN pi.status = '识别成功' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successNum, AVG(pi.duration) AS avgDuration, MAX(s.name) AS stationName FROM plate_identify pi INNER JOIN station_info s ON pi.station_id = s.id WHERE pi.deleted = 0 AND pi.create_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime}) AND pi.create_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime})
AND pi.station_id = #{stationId}
